verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented retention settings, retention periods, or deletion API for parsed files and job results. The only route to control is indirect: self-hosted/BYOC deployment keeps "your data, models, and infrastructure under your control," alongside single-tenant and regional deployment options. Missing for 10: explicit data retention policy or configurable retention windows, a file/job deletion endpoint or UI, zero-retention mode on the managed SaaS, and independent corroboration.
